name: Duskin Co., Ltd.
summary: Duskin Co., Ltd. engages in the environmental hygiene and food businesses in Japan and internationally. It is involved in the rental and sale of cleaning and hygiene products; leasing, sale, and cleaning of uniforms; sale of natural cosmetics and health foods products; and comprehensive event support. The company offers cleaning/beautification-related items such as mats, mops, cabinet towels, and air purifiers.
